text:
maya: heads up — multiple customers reporting p95/p99 jumps on /v1/generate, some with intermittent 401s after the auth-service deploy. spikes started ~09:20pt. sample customer acme-prod, opened support ticket.
sam: thanks. are these 401s or 5xx? any request examples?
maya: mostly 401s, a few 504s. quick repro curl we used:
maya: ```\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\\n  -d '{\"model\":\"rw-large\",\"input\":\"hi\"}'\n```
owen: I see auth-service deployed at 09:15. @sre-bot can you pull deploy + error windows? 
sre-bot: deploy: auth-service v2.14.3 at 2026-03-17T09:15:12Z; error-rate spike 09:18-09:27; affected region: us-west1.
sam: quick glance at logs: `auth: token lookup timeout 1.5s` then `upstream timeout` — looks like token validation latency causing auth checks to time out -> 401.
lisa: also correlating with traffic pattern of tiny requests. continuous-batcher set to timeout_ms=50 and max_batch_size=1 for this route, so we get many small microbatches and a burst of concurrent auth validations. saw KV cache missstorm.
maya: customer p99 jumped to ~1.8s from ~450ms. need fast mitigation.
owen: mitigation plan — (1) increase continuous_batcher.timeout_ms from 50 -> 120 for the generate route; (2) enable auth-service degraded/cached-accept mode for ~200ms window; (3) route heavy customers to dedicated pool if needed. I'll push a canary for (1) now.
sam: can we validate in staging? repro patch yaml:
sam: ```yaml
route: /v1/generate
continuous_batcher:
  max_batch_size: 8
  timeout_ms: 120
```
maya: applied canary -> p99 dropped to ~520ms and 401s disappeared on canary traffic.
lisa: rolling to 25% now. watching p95/p99 and auth errors. alert threshold set p99>800ms.
sre-bot: rollout started 2026-03-17T09:45Z to 25% in us-west1.
maya: customer confirmed improvement, will keep monitoring until full rollout or RCA done.
owen: follow-up action items: tune default small-req continuous_batcher timeouts, add soft-auth cache for token decisions, and run load test for microburst patterns. create ticket.
sam: created INF-4872 with repro steps and canary results, assigned to eng-runtime.
maya: thanks team :thumbsup:
